"""Paint the planned image with isolated, straight sweeps of the vertical brush.
The accompanying strokes.json stores endpoints in sheet millimetres, press depth,
and the premixed well index. All saved actions come from Session primitives.
"""
import os,json,time,argparse
os.environ.setdefault('RCB_RENDER','0')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

def generate(stroke_file='/app/output/strokes.json',out='/app/output/trajectory.npz'):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False)
 p=s.primitives();move=p['move_tip'];wells=s.wells()
 s.record_start();t=time.time();loaded=None
 strokes=json.load(open(stroke_file))
 for i,st in enumerate(strokes):
  c=st['color'];a=s.geo.mm_to_world(*st['a']);b=s.geo.mm_to_world(*st['b']);z=.020-st['depth']/1000
  # A fresh dip for each sweep makes its colour and brush state reproducible.
  w=wells[c]['center_xy']
  move([*w,.055],speed=.25,settle=2)
  move([*w,.025],speed=.08,settle=2)
  move([*w,.055],speed=.10,settle=2)
  move([*a,.045],speed=.25,settle=3)
  move([*a,z],speed=.04,settle=3)
  move([*b,z],speed=.05,settle=3)
  move([*b,.045],speed=.08,settle=3)
  if (i+1)%25==0:
   print(i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',round(time.time()-t),flush=True)
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/actual.png')
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,out)
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/actual.png')
 print('Saved',out,len(actions),'state',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 print(json.dumps(s.status(),indent=2),flush=True)
 return s
if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--strokes',default='/app/output/strokes.json');ap.add_argument('--out',default='/app/output/trajectory.npz');a=ap.parse_args();generate(a.strokes,a.out)
PY

def metrics(path):

 de=np.linalg.norm(t-c,axis=2)[36:-36,36:-36]
 a=t[:,:,0];b=c[:,:,0];sig=1.5/.22186
 ma=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),sig);mb=cv2.GaussianBlur(b,(0,0),sig)
 va=cv2.GaussianBlur(a*a,(0,0),sig)-ma*ma;vb=cv2.GaussianBlur(b*b,(0,0),sig)-mb*mb;cov=cv2.GaussianBlur(a*b,(0,0),sig)-ma*mb

 return dict(de=float(de.mean()),p90=float(np.percentile(de,90)),ssim=float(ss),edge=float(np.corrcoef(ga.ravel(),gb.ravel())[0,1]))
